items.title: Bitcoin Core 30-Day Fuzz — Day 11
items.summary: Week-2 deep pass: CheckTransaction duplicate inputs (CVE-2018-17144 class). 256 runs, 24 guard signals, zero critical, 106s.
items.impact: 4× run budget vs Day 4 on the same WASM guard — hunts edge cases in prevout dedup. Honest triage: rejections on duplicate-prevout encodings, not a new inflation CVE.

items.title: Bitcoin Core 30-Day Fuzz — Day 10
items.summary: BIP34 coinbase height push guard. Live campaign: 128 runs, 80 guard signals, zero critical, 31s.

items.title: Bitcoin Core 30-Day Fuzz — Day 9
items.summary: Week 2 continues: MAX_BLOCK_WEIGHT (4M WU) guard from Bitcoin Core consensus policy. Live HackMe campaign: 128 runs, 80 guard signals, zero critical, 30s wall time.
items.impact: First block-level guard in the series (post-script week). Honest triage: overweight candidates flagged, not CVE claims. Public HTML + reproducible DAY=9 script.

items.title: Bitcoin Core 30-Day Fuzz — Day 8 (Week 2)
items.summary: Week 2 kickoff: EvalScript MAX_STACK_SIZE guard from bitcoin/bitcoin interpreter — combined main+alt stack must stay ≤1000 elements. Live campaign on HackMe node: 64 runs, 64 guard signals, zero critical, 15s wall time.
items.impact: Daily cadence continues after Week 1 wrap. Strong B2B proof: real Core stack budget, honest guard_signal triage, public HTML ledger — not fake CVE noise.

items.title: Live fuzz security audits — Solana SPL & Bitcoin Core guards (completed)
items.summary: We ran two real customer-style security audits on a local HackMe node: upstream WASM guards (Solana Token owner-check, Bitcoin Core HasValidOps), local autorunner, HMC fuzz escrow, and fuzz_report_v2 HTML with executive summary, triage, and repro_cmd. Solana: 64/64 runs, warn_guard_signals (detector semantics — guard signals, not mainnet CVEs). Bitcoin: 48/48 runs in seconds, warn_medium, 0 critical/high. Operator phasing gate: 37 pass / 0 fail on the same wallet pipeline.
items.impact: B2B audits are live on the node — not slides. Customers run Security audit on localhost; reports are token-gated. Choose pow_gate + upstream guards for honest executive verdicts; detector-only on strict guards can look like dozens of highs without triage context.
items.action: Local node: http://127.0.0.1:8080/#orders (Security audit) · Fuzz guide: https://hackme.tech/fuzz-guide.html · Downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html#local-node
